tubuild reconcile note: the generated preamble was discarded and the TU hand-curated, so none of the conflict markers the warnings above were frozen against are present in src_tu/actors/daMip_c.cpp. Each was reconciled deliberately rather than by picking a side. FUNCTION declarations were reduced to ONE signature per symbol in a single file-scope extern "C" region -- a class member function may not sit inside a linkage specification, so there is no other place to put them -- and the reconciled spelling is the widest that keeps every call site's codegen: pointer parameters became void *, and two return types were forced by use rather than by majority (Sound::PlaySub and _Z14ApproachLinearRsss are tested in an `if` by StateTalkMain, so the `void` three of the four legacy files declared cannot be right, and RandomIntInternal is unsigned because InitResources shifts its result right by 8 and the ROM uses LSR). DATA declarations were NOT reconciled: each stays block-scope inside the member that recovered it, because the legacy files genuinely disagreed about the shape of the same ov085 statics -- 0x021305c0 alone was spelled int[], struct G { int w[2]; }, an incomplete struct S, void *[] and plain char -- and mwccarm leaves a file-scope variable's name unmangled in C++, so a block-scope extern still names the ROM symbol. The two shadow-type conflicts went the same way: the Vector3 and Fix12 typedefs stay inside their own members. The two RAW warnings are likewise resolved -- both bodies were carried out of their legacy extern "C" blocks and are now real daMip_c methods. Marked (RESOLVED) rather than deleted, so the record that the legacy files disagreed about these names survives. Checked by tools/check_tubuild_conflicts.py.

linkcheck note: `tools/tubuild.py linkcheck ov085/daMip_c` cannot be the pre-promotion proof for THIS TU, and the reason is structural rather than a failure of the fold. The promotion carries a symbol rename -- 23 auto-named ov085 members become daMip_c methods in config/arm9/overlays/ov085/symbols.txt -- so there is no intermediate tree state that links: before the rename the merged TU defines names symbols.txt does not carry, and after it the 32 legacy shards define names it no longer carries. compiler_only_output.reason: mwccarm emits the base-object destructor beside the licensed D1/D0 pair. The cartridge has no D2 for this class -- ov085 runs D1 at 0x0212a6d4 straight into D0 at 0x0212a724 and then into TestWaterBelow at 0x0212a788, with no third variant anywhere in the image -- so there is no configured home and no surviving relocation references it.

StateFleeInit declares three Vector3 locals, so this TU re-emits Vector3's vague-linkage D1 alongside its own text. The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0 and an enrolled source already owns it; rombuild compares this object's body against those cartridge bytes and refuses anything but byte-identical vague-linkage output before discarding the duplicate.

This TU owns daMip_c's key function -- ~daMip_c is the first virtual declared and its body is out of line here -- so mwcc emits the complete 0x84-byte class vtable storage with its ABI preamble. The cartridge's public address point is ov085:0x021300f8, eight bytes above the start of storage and outside this text-only entry's licensed range, so dsd supplies that ROM data independently. romdata_check applies the measured eight-byte address-point bias and proves every emitted slot and relocation against the cartridge before production isolation discards the copy.
